## Frequently asked questions

### Where is The Origin Play School?

### What facilities does The Origin Play School have?
Play Group, Pre-Nursery, Junior KG, Senior KG, Ages 2–5, Sports class, Music class, Drawing class, Rhymes & phonetic sounds, Yoga, Festival celebrations, Counselling support, Registered under Govt. of Tamil Nadu.
